crossRefs.note: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One…
But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you.…
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a…
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I!…
He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here.…
When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the…
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
